regime_policy.approved_upper_bound_rationale: The cited in-situ literature supports slack near 2.0 µm and folded-tandem/PEVK serial extension through the 2.0-2.4 µm model interval. Above 2.4 µm PEVK dominance and cross-preparation transfer grow; at 2.5 µm a conservative project cutoff prevents use of the no-unfolding solver where conflicting in-situ and single-molecule Ig evidence becomes material. The 2.5 µm cutoff is policy, not a measured transition.

regimes.reason: Below 2000 nm, or at/above 2500 nm, omitted slack/contact/compression or Ig-transition physics makes tensile force not evaluated.
2000-2400 nm is the literature-supported interval for this explicitly transferred reference-sequence model.
Above 2400 and below 2500 nm output is labelled extrapolated because PEVK contribution and transfer sensitivity increase.

sensitivity_policy.reason: The envelope evaluates documented literature endpoints one at a time around the central source parameterization. No covariance model is asserted; this is not a confidence interval, biological population variance, or experimental error bar.

precision.reason: Displayed precision is limited by the one-at-a-time literature sensitivity envelope and never implies experimental certainty.

output_policy.public_caveat: Approximate passive force per titin for a tissue-neutral Q8WZ42-1 reference-sequence model, not a measured or tissue-specific human force. Material values transfer rat/rabbit skeletal-muscle and recombinant-human evidence. The band is one-at-a-time literature parameter sensitivity, not a confidence interval or biological variance. Slack/contact/compression and Ig unfolding/refolding are omitted; force is not evaluated below 2000 nm or at/above 2500 nm.
